title: President
about: Right Build International specializes in construction management, general contracting, and program management services, with a mission to deliver construction excellence while always putting safety and the customer first. Karl merged his IT, design, and management background to found RBI in 2008, building lasting relationships with municipalities, higher ed institutions, public school systems, health care, and private clients across the region.
notes: Office Hours: Mon-Thurs 8 AM - 5 PM, Fri 8 AM - 3:30 PM.
